_about: Every sentence a player can see, keyed, one per language code: en, fr, it, de, es-ES, es-419, pt-BR, ru, uk, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, pl, tr. A sentence missing in a language is shown in English. Every key needs en and ko. Keep each {placeholder} as it is; the words around it may move. Use the game's own words and the Korean terms in GLOSSARY.md. Korean uses formal endings and calls a player '{name} 님'. Keys starting with config. are BepInEx setting descriptions, kept in English only.

notice.modDisabled.en: The mod is off because it does not match this game version.
notice.modDisabled.ko: 지금 게임 버전과 맞지 않아 모드를 껐습니다.

notice.modDisabledByCoopMod.en: The mod is off because Co-op Mod is also installed. Remove Co-op Mod to play.

notice.pairFormed.ko: {carrier} 님이 {rider} 님을 업습니다. {carrier} 님은 키보드, {rider} 님은 마우스로 조작합니다.

notice.preferenceOverridden.en: Roles clashed, so {player} takes the other role.
notice.preferenceOverridden.ko: 원하는 역할이 겹쳐 {player} 님은 다른 역할을 맡습니다.

notice.unpaired.en: {player} plays without a Pair for now.

notice.pairDissolved.en: The Pair of {carrier} and {rider} has ended.

notice.planAnnounced.ko: 분대장이 짝 계획을 통보했습니다. ESC → 편성표에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

notice.reportArrived.en: The Run Report is in. See ESC → Roster.

notice.tooSoon.ko: 방금 한 일입니다. 잠시 뒤 다시 해 주세요.

notice.rulesChanged.en: The Troop Leader changed the Run Rules. {changes}

notice.swapOffered.en: {partner} wants to swap places. Press Swap Places in ESC → Roster to agree.
notice.swapOffered.ko: {partner} 님이 자리를 바꾸고 싶어 합니다. ESC → 편성표에서 자리 바꾸기를 누르면 바꿉니다.

notice.swapWithdrawn.en: {partner} no longer asks to swap places.

notice.riderHandEmptied.en: A Rider cannot hold items, so the item in hand was put down.

notice.riderBackEmptied.en: A Rider cannot wear a back item, so it was put down.

notice.recovered.en: The Troop Leader put every Pair back together and woke every Rider.

notice.oddPlayerCount.en: An even number of players who can pair is needed to depart. ({pairable})

notice.unmoddedPlayer.ko: {player} 님에게는 모드가 없어 짝 없이 함께 오릅니다.

notice.resting.en: The Troop Leader {leader} does not have BetterCoop. The mod rests in this room; you climb without a Pair.

roster.noPartner.en: You have no partner for now

roster.aboutNoPartner.en: You get a partner when another player is free or the Pairs shuffle.
roster.aboutNoPartner.ko: 짝 없는 대원이 또 생기거나 짝을 섞을 때 짝이 생깁니다.

roster.aboutRolePreference.en: The role you would like when Pairs are formed or shuffled; applies from the next time.
roster.aboutRolePreference.ko: 짝 편성과 짝 섞기에서 원하는 역할입니다. 다음 번부터 적용됩니다.

roster.aboutSwapNotAllowed.en: The Troop Leader has not allowed swapping places.

roster.aboutNextShuffle.en: Time left until the next Timed Shuffle.

roster.draft.ko: 초안입니다. 통보하기 전에는 아무도 바뀌지 않습니다.

roster.discardDraftNote.en:
The Pairs you laid out have not been announced.
If you discard it, the list goes back to the current Pairs.
roster.discardDraftNote.ko:
통보하지 않은 짝 명단 초안이 있습니다.
지우면 지금의 짝 명단으로 돌아갑니다.

roster.planHelp.en: Set the Pairs before departure. On arrival the Pairs form as planned; anyone left out is paired by lot.
roster.planHelp.ko: 출발 전에 짝을 미리 정해 둘 수 있습니다. 섬에 도착하면 이 계획대로 짝을 편성하고, 계획에 없는 대원은 제비뽑기로 짝을 짓습니다.

roster.planFromLastRun.en: The same scouts as last Run, so the draft starts from the Pairs that Run ended with. Announce it to make it the plan.

roster.planNone.en: The Troop Leader has not planned the Pairs yet; on arrival they are drawn by lot.
roster.planNone.ko: 분대장이 아직 짝 계획을 세우지 않았습니다. 섬에 도착하면 제비뽑기로 짝을 짓습니다.

roster.aboutPlan.en: Once announced, everyone is told, and the Pairs form this way on arrival.
roster.aboutPlan.ko: 통보하면 모두에게 알리고, 섬에 도착할 때 이대로 짝을 편성합니다.

roster.aboutShufflePlan.en: Fills the draft with Pairs drawn by lot; announce it to make it the plan.
roster.aboutShufflePlan.ko: 짝 계획 초안을 제비뽑기로 채웁니다. 통보해야 계획이 됩니다.

roster.aboutCallOff.en: Calls off the Pair Shuffle that is coming; the Timed Shuffle counts again from the start.
roster.aboutCallOff.ko: 곧 있을 짝 섞기를 취소합니다. 시간마다 짝 섞기는 처음부터 다시 셉니다.

roster.aboutRecover.en: Puts every Rider back on their Carrier and wakes them.
roster.aboutRecover.ko: 업기가 풀렸을 때 모든 짝을 다시 업히고 업힌 사람을 깨웁니다.

roster.aboutCarryRecord.en: How long each scout carried and rode this Run, how high they climbed carrying, and how long they carried a rescued scout. Time unpaired or down counts only for rescues.
roster.aboutCarryRecord.ko: 이번 원정에서 업고, 업히고, 업은 채 오르고, 기절한 대원을 구조해 업은 만큼입니다. 짝이 없거나 쓰러져 있던 시간은 구조 말고는 세지 않습니다.

roster.aboutRunReport.en: During a Run it shows the record so far; once the Run ends, its result and Merit Badges. The next Run starts a new one.
roster.aboutRunReport.ko: 원정 중에는 지금까지의 기록이, 원정이 끝나면 결과와 공로 배지가 실립니다. 다음 원정이 출발하면 새로 씁니다.

roster.rulesRead.en: The rules the Troop Leader set for this Run. A telegram tells you when they change.
roster.rulesRead.ko: 분대장이 정한 이번 원정의 규칙입니다. 바뀌면 전보로 알려 드립니다.

roster.rulesLeaderOnly.en: The Troop Leader sets the Run Rules.

rule.followRolePreferences.about.en: Scouts get the role they wish for where it fits; off, roles are drawn by lot.
rule.followRolePreferences.about.ko: 짝을 정할 때 대원이 원하는 역할을 되도록 들어줍니다. 끄면 역할을 제비뽑기로 정합니다.

rule.allowSwapRequests.about.en: The two of a Pair may trade Carrier and Rider when both ask.
rule.allowSwapRequests.about.ko: 짝 둘이 함께 요청하면 업는 사람과 업힌 사람을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

rule.latePairing.about.en: Two scouts without a partner are paired at once; off, they climb alone until the next shuffle.
rule.latePairing.about.ko: 짝 없는 대원이 둘 생기면 바로 짝을 지어 줍니다. 끄면 다음 짝 섞기까지 혼자 오릅니다.

rule.allowOddPlayerCount.about.en: Lets a Run depart with an odd count; one player climbs without a Pair.
rule.allowOddPlayerCount.about.ko: 인원이 홀수여도 출발합니다. 남는 대원은 짝 없이 올라갑니다.

rule.campfireShuffle.about.en: Forms the Pairs anew when a campfire is lit.
rule.campfireShuffle.about.ko: 모닥불을 피워 다음 구간으로 갈 때 짝을 새로 정합니다.

rule.timedShuffle.about.en: Forms the Pairs anew at a fixed interval.

rule.timedShuffleInterval.about.en: How often a Timed Shuffle comes.

rule.handOverPlace.about.en: A new Carrier starts where the Carrier before them stood.
rule.handOverPlace.about.ko: 짝이 바뀌면 새로 업는 대원이 앞서 업던 대원의 자리에서 이어 오릅니다.

rule.handOverItems.about.en: A new Carrier takes over the items of the Carrier before them.
rule.handOverItems.about.ko: 짝이 바뀌면 새로 업는 대원이 앞서 업던 대원의 소지품을 이어받습니다.

rule.carryWeight.about.en: Carriers feel the weight of the person they carry.
rule.carryWeight.about.ko: 업는 사람이 업힌 사람의 무게를 느낍니다.

rule.rescueCarry.about.en: A Pair can carry a passed-out scout on the Rider's back; a scout without a partner can carry a passed-out Pair.
rule.rescueCarry.about.ko: 기절한 대원을 업힌 사람의 등에 얹어 업을 수 있습니다. 짝 없는 대원은 기절한 짝을 통째로 업습니다.

rule.riderPicksFromBackpack.about.en: The Rider picks from the backpack wheel; off, the Carrier does.
rule.riderPicksFromBackpack.about.ko: 가방 휠에서 업힌 사람이 아이템을 고릅니다. 끄면 업는 사람이 고릅니다.

report.underway.en: The Run is still under way. The Troop Leader writes the record anew every 15 seconds and whenever the Pairs change.
report.underway.ko: 아직 원정 중입니다. 분대장이 짝이 바뀔 때와 15초마다 기록을 새로 적습니다.

report.gone.en: The next Run has departed, and the report with it.

config.allowOddPlayerCount.en: Let a Run depart with an odd number of players; the extra player stays an Unpaired Player. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.rolePreference.en: Your wish when Pairs are formed: Carrier (keyboard), Rider (mouse), or Random for either. Conflicts are settled at random.

config.followRolePreferences.en: When Pairs are formed, shuffled, or paired late, give players their Role Preference where it fits. Off: roles are drawn at random. A Pair Plan or Pair Assignment always comes first. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.allowSwapRequests.en: Let the two of a Pair trade Carrier and Rider when both ask for it. The Troop Leader can always set roles on the Roster. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.latePairing.en: During a Run, pair two players without a partner as soon as there are two. Off: they climb alone until the next Pair Shuffle or Pair Assignment. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.riderPicksFromBackpack.en: In a backpack wheel the Carrier opens, the Rider picks with the mouse while the Carrier holds the key. Off: the Carrier picks, and only the Carrier sees the wheel. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.rescueCarry.en: Let a Pair carry a passed-out scout on the Rider's back, and anyone without a partner carry a passed-out Pair, so the time they have left stops running out. Off: a Pair can only help a passed-out scout where they lie. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.carryWeight.en: Apply the game's weight for carrying a person to every Carrier. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.campfireShuffle.en: Form the Pairs anew when a campfire is lit and the Run moves on to the next segment. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.timedShuffle.en: Form the Pairs anew at a fixed interval. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.timedShuffleInterval.en: How often a Timed Shuffle comes, in minutes ({min}-{max}). The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.handOverPlace.en: When Pairs change, each new Carrier moves to where the Shared Body they take over stood. Riders always move to their new Carrier. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.handOverItems.en: When Pairs change, each new Carrier takes over the items of the Shared Body they take over; the items swap, so nothing is lost. Statuses are always handed over. The Troop Leader's value applies.

config.verboseLog.en: Write detailed pairing, carry, and Control Split diagnostics to LogOutput.log.
